  - paragraph: "No named competitors in the freight forwarding or logistics sector appear in the SPC Impact 2026 source materials. The competitive pressure at this stage operates at the cargo-principal level (brands, retailers, CPG companies) rather than at the forwarder level. However, the commercial implication is directional: workspaces whose clients include the brands named at SPC Impact 2026 (Conagra, Mondelēz, Sonoco, P&G, Amazon, Walmart, Target) will face increasing requests for packaging sustainability data, EPR compliance documentation, and recyclability verification as those clients build internal compliance infrastructure."
  - paragraph: The SPC Retailer Forum's active role — Amazon, Walmart, and Target collectively seeking supplier-side sustainable packaging solutions — signals that packaging sustainability will increasingly appear as a vendor qualification or supplier scorecard criterion. Workspaces that can document sustainable packaging use, EPR compliance status, or How2Recycle label adoption for their own transit packaging may gain a differentiation point in commercial conversations with retail-sector clients.
